style_block: Isometric technical illustration, orthographic camera from one corner looking down 30 degrees, no perspective. Hairline even-weight linework on every edge. Flat four-tone shading by face direction, top faces lightest. Warm paper background for day scenes, dark navy-charcoal for night. Only parts that show live data are brass, and each carries fine engraved scale marks; every other material follows the scene's architectural tradition. Exactly one part highlighted in vivid orange: the place where value is moving right now. Engineering-drawing precision with dense, purposeful detail. Calm, legible and serious, like a plate in an engineering atlas.
avoid_block: Avoid: perspective, vanishing points, depth of field, photographic lighting, soft gradients, bloom, neon, holograms, casino imagery, coins and dollar signs, text, letters, numbers, arrows, callouts, motion lines, watermarks, real brand logos, faces on robots, identical islands, generic steampunk clutter, decorative gears, brass on decorative parts, more than one orange highlight.
